## CELL FACTS

Cell 金_偏印 (Metal carrying The Alchemist). Persona The Alchemist (偏印). Definition line: "Unconventional nourishment, the insight that transmutes". Keyword Insight, charge fierce, poles catalyst Vision / friction Distance. Family function: Mind. Cost dimension: nourishment that transmutes; fed on strange food, recipe unshareable. Arena: crucible, moon-side, distillation, the changed substance. Classical portrait: unorthodox absorption; solitary mastery; intake that starves output (枭神夺食). Ruled domains: Learning, Intuition, Solitude. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 正印.
Element arena: Metal (edge, blade, ore, forge, whetstone, the clean line). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Water. structural_interaction seed: "Metal generating Water same-polarity — precision as the source sustaining depth".
- k2_overview: "Your Metal moves as the Alchemist: a mind that refines. You take raw knowledge and smelt it, testing claims, discarding slag, keeping only what rings true when struck. Your insight is assay-grade and arrives in solitude. Share the refined ingots. The lonely part of the craft is the furnace, not the life."
- k2_functional: "You think by refinement: melt the claim, pour off error, keep the metal."
- adj_chips: {"catalyst":["Fine-tuned","Selective","Ingenious"],"friction":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Learning":"You learn by testing: every teaching struck against evidence before acceptance. Slow intake, permanent retention. Choose dense material worth the smelting. Shallow content wastes your furnace.","Intuition":"Your intuition is metallurgical: a felt sense for what is alloyed with falsehood. When something rings wrong, it is wrong. Trust the ear and verify the details later.","Solitude":"Solitude is your workshop: insight forms only with the door closed. Guard those hours without apology. Just open the shop some evenings. Refined gold unshared stays ore."}

- Sibling cell 金_正印 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Discreet","Preserving","Old soul"],"friction":["Detached","Formal","Locked-away"]}
- Sibling cell 金_正印 friction row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Your care operates at instrument distance. The concern is genuine and arrives as analysis, the love is real and expressed as protocol, and the people receiving it stand slightly cold in the accuracy, holding perfectly correct advice, wishing it had arms."

Core element Water, energy element Metal. Law: Metal feeds Water (金生水: dew beads on the cold blade). Relative to the core the energy is the feeder, so Metal is this core's Mind. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Water core that shows Metal on the friction pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The friction pole of Metal as the Mind is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels); tone by pole: reminder. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 水_金's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.

value.text: You are never done checking. Letting a thing out early feels like a mistake you cannot undo, so you check once more rather than hand it over. Remember that you stopped finding errors long ago and now check for comfort.

value_b.text: Checking is the part you trust most. Only a fully tested thing feels safe to you, and that keeps you checking what already passed instead of letting it go. You know already that the third check finds nothing the second one missed.

value.text: Whenever someone asks, you reply only once the answer is fully checked. Late sits easier with you than wrong, and you leave whoever asked waiting on your standard instead of your reply. You owe them a rough version now more than a right one later.

value.text: Precision matters to you past the point of being followed. A near-enough answer feels like a small lie to you, so you give the precise one rather than the easy one. Most days you get one of exact or understood, and one is enough.

value_b.text: Nothing you say is allowed to be roughly right. Your own standard makes a loose word feel like an error, and that puts being exact ahead of being easy to listen to. Worth remembering, you were understood long before you were precise.

value.text: Hard to reach is what you become when a thought is unfinished. You need it whole before anyone touches it, so you let messages wait rather than answer half-minded. Keep in mind that you will find the thought again sooner than the person.

value_b.text: You think best when unreachable. Quiet matters more to you than being easy to find, and the thought gets finished while the call goes unanswered. You keep forgetting that a finished thought is worth something only once it reaches somebody.
